seam: Board 1 establishes why neither classical wave nor classical particle models suffice for light. Board 2 extends the same tension to matter and states the quantum link between amplitudes and localized outcomes.

info.text: Wave and particle descriptions for light and matter: classical models and light evidence first, then matter-wave experiments and the quantum framework linking amplitudes to localized outcomes.

entries.reason: Continue to matter-wave evidence and the quantum rules that connect probability amplitudes to localized measurement outcomes.
